scripts.build: npm run build -w @bnk-decoder/core && npm run build -w @bnk-decoder/question-model && npm run build -w bnk-decoder
scripts.check: npm run check -w @bnk-decoder/core && npm run check -w @bnk-decoder/question-model && npm run check -w bnk-decoder
scripts.pqp:precalc12: node scripts/mathpix-to-pqp.mjs 'ignore/Mathpix/Pre-Calculus 12' reports/pqp/pre-calculus-12 data/pqp-overrides/pre-calculus-12.json && npm run -s pqp:algorithms -- reports/pqp/pre-calculus-12 'ignore/ExamView/Banks/Pre-Calculus 12' data/algorithm-overrides/pre-calculus-12.json
scripts.pqp:mickelson12: node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/bnk-records-to-pqp.mjs 'ignore/ExamView/Banks/Pre-Calculus 12 (Mickelson)' reports/pqp/pre-calculus-12-mickelson data/pqp-banks/pre-calculus-12-mickelson.json data/pqp-overrides/pre-calculus-12-mickelson.json && npm run -s pqp:algorithms -- reports/pqp/pre-calculus-12-mickelson 'ignore/ExamView/Banks/Pre-Calculus 12 (Mickelson)'
